images.alt: Title slide: "Stop making your minis look worse than they are" over a before and after of Spider-Punk
Tip 1, use a clean background: a hand placing a mini in front of black paper curved over a stack of books
Tip 2, shoot by a window or use a daylight bulb: a gold desk lamp aimed down at the mini
Tip 3, no tripod: a phone propped in a mug, aimed at the mini on the paper backdrop
Tip 4, tap to focus and move back: a finger tapping the phone screen in the mug
Tip 5, find the golden angle: a hand turning the mini on the backdrop while the phone shoots
Before and after of the same Spider-Punk mini: a cluttered desk shot next to a clean backdrop shot
End slide: the whole setup on the desk, lamp, paper backdrop, books and phone in a mug
